title: Border and Cipher Again
author: Ulyana Voss
blurb: Lena Hartwell, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
